title: Regular expression compiled from a non-literal (python)
description: Code in python passes a runtime value to re.compile or a related re function. Attacker-chosen patterns can backtrack exponentially and tie up a worker. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the pattern is fixed or switches to a raw string literal or a vetted pattern table.
remediation: Use a raw string literal, or select from a vetted pattern table, or use the regex module with a timeout where patterns must be dynamic.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags any non-literal first argument. Trusted variables are flagged as well.
